title: An Open-Label, Randomized, Cross-Over Study to Investigate the Efficacy and Safety of Mexiletine PR compared to Mexiletine IR in Patients with Non-Dystrophic Myotonias (ACHILLES study)
official: An Open-Label, Randomized, Cross-Over Study to Investigate the Efficacy and Safety of Mexiletine PR compared to Mexiletine IR in Patients with Non-Dystrophic Myotonias (ACHILLES study)
summary: Main objective: To compare the safety of mexiletine PR vs mexiletine IR for the symptomatic treatment of myotonia in adult patients with non-dystrophic myotonias (myotonia congenita (MC), paramyotonia congenita (PC) and sodium channel myotonia (SCM)).
